There was a time when I deposited ~$2,000 cash into an ATM after a large craft show and the ATM immediately turned off and I didn't get a receipt or anything. I called them and they put the funds into my account over the phone, the next day the bank manager called to say the funds were in the machine, and about a week after that I got a letter in the mail apologizing for the inconvenience and the receipt for the deposit. This could have been a disaster and taken a long time, but they handled it perfectly and immediately.

I signed up for a background check website with a pretty bad reputation. Either pay $29.99 for one check, or pay 99 cents now for unlimited checks, but have a reoccurring monthly payment of $59.99 starting in 30 days. I went for the 99 cents, well after I got the background check I couldn't find out how to cancel the reoccurring payment, called BOA, told them what was going on, never had any money ever taken by the website, not even the first 99 cents, and I never heard from them after that.

All that being said, I keep a rather large balance, I have never had a bounced check, overdraft, or anything like that. So maybe my experience is not typical.
